8 اعتصب بِالعِمَامَةِ [He attired himself, or surrounded his head, with the turban], and بِالتَّاجِ [with the crown]. (S, O.) And اعتصب التَّاجَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ He encircled his [own] head with the crown. (Az, TA.) ―
-b2- اعتصب النَّاقَةَ: see 1, in the middle of the first quarter. ―
-b3- اعتصبوا They became formed, or collected, into companies such as those whereof one is called عُصْبَة: (K:) or, into one of such companies. (M, L, TA.) [See also 12.] ―
-b4- اعتصب بِهِ: see 5, last sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
